gpuMemory.method: Windows WDDM per-process GPU memory counters, summed only for browser descendants of the benchmark process. Includes browser allocation overhead; not app-only texture bytes or a physical VRAM census.

environment.renderer: ANGLE (NVIDIA, NVIDIA GeForce GTX 980 Direct3D11 vs_5_0 ps_5_0), or similar
environment.memoryMeaning: Heap and renderer counters are not physical GPU memory measurements.

method: Actual engine render notifications grouped by browser RAF timestamp, with duplicate submissions retained as counts. Frame times are completed CPU submission cadence; FPS uses rolling 60-frame windows of unique rendered RAF opportunities, not direct display-scanout or GPU-execution measurement. No slow intervals are filtered. The reference budget is fixed to mid before measurement, independently of simulation density auto-adjustment. Heap is a browser estimate; GPU memory needs a separate owned-process Windows counter.
